facts.fact: The Joint SDG Fund reports Senegal's first e-justice platform is a pilot at the Pikine-Guediawaye court, already run on its internal computers with case files being digitised, with go-live planned for September 2025 and Dakar-wide rollout from October.

SEN.note: A mini data centre for judicial data is not stated to be for hire or nationally owned.
A backup site is mentioned with no place named or in-service date, so distance is not shown.
